name: Micro Motion 5700 (USB Service Port)
description: Modbus RTU service-port profile. Address 111 (0x6F) is the reserved Micro Motion service address and always answers on the service port. A valid CRC-checked reply proves two-way communication even when the function code is unsupported.

commands.name: Service port reachability (Report Slave ID)
commands.notes: A Modbus exception reply is an acceptable pass: it proves the device received and answered a correctly framed request.
